<content>1: # Configuración de Rutas
2: $Source = Resolve-Path "$PSScriptRoot\.."
3: $Source = $Source.Path
4: $Destination = "C:\Users\paulm\obsidian-sync\content"
5: 
6: 
7: # Forzar codificación para evitar problemas con tildes
8: [Console]::OutputEncoding = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8
9: 
10: Write-Host "Iniciando Sincronizacion..." -ForegroundColor Cyan
11: Write-Host "Origen: $Source"
12: Write-Host "Destino: $Destination"
13: Write-Host "-----------------------------"
14: 
15: # 1. ROBOCOPY
16: Write-Host "1. Ejecutando Robocopy..." -ForegroundColor Yellow
17: 
18: $ExcludeDirs = @(".obsidian", ".git", ".smart-connections", ".smart-env", ".trash", "scripts", "utils", "Weeklynotes", "Biohacking Week (newsletter)", "suplementacion-app")
19: $ExcludeFiles = @("desktop.ini", "*.DS_Store", "*.gdoc")
20: 
21: $roboArgs = @(
22:     $Source,
23:     $Destination,
24:     "/MIR",
25:     "/FFT",
26:     "/R:1",
27:     "/W:1",
28:     "/XD", $ExcludeDirs,
29:     "/XF", $ExcludeFiles,
30:     "/NP",
31:     "/NDL"
32: )
33: 
34: # Ejecutar Robocopy
35: & robocopy @roboArgs
36: 
37: if ($LASTEXITCODE -ge 8) {
38:     Write-Host "ERROR CRITICO EN ROBOCOPY. Codigo: $LASTEXITCODE" -ForegroundColor Red
39:     Read-Host "Presiona Enter para salir..."
40:     Exit
41: }
42: else {
43:     Write-Host "Robocopy completado." -ForegroundColor Green
44: }
45: 
46: # 2. GIT
47: Write-Host "2. Verificando Git..." -ForegroundColor Yellow
48: 
49: Set-Location -Path "C:\Users\paulm\obsidian-sync"
50: 
51: $gitStatus = git status --porcelain
52: if (-not $gitStatus) {
53:     Write-Host "No hay cambios para subir." -ForegroundColor Green
54: }
55: else {
56:     Write-Host "Subiendo cambios a GitHub..."
57:     git add .
58:     
59:     $timestamp = Get-Date -Format "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss"
60:     $commitMsg = "Obsidian Sync: $timestamp"
61:     
62:     git commit -m "$commitMsg"
63:     
64:     git push origin main
65:     if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
66:         Write-Host "Reintentando con master..."
67:         git push origin master
68:     }
69: }
70: 
71: Write-Host "-----------------------------"
72: Write-Host "LISTO. PANTALLA SE CERRARA."
73: Write-Host "-----------------------------"
74: Start-Sleep -Seconds 5
